module: Small module of the freeform delivery mode (freeformDelivery) that gathers the statistics displayed at the end of a delivery: elapsed time, goal progress (via gameplay_freeformDelivery_goals.getProgress) and damage of each vehicle of the delivery (read from map.objects). Contains no UI: it only builds the results table.
notes: Time is computed with os.clock() - startTime: startTime must therefore come from os.clock().
Returns nil (with a logged error) if delivery is nil, if startTime is nil or 0, or if getProgress returns nothing.

collectStatistics.desc: Builds the end-of-delivery statistics table: duration (raw and formatted by gameplay_freeformDelivery_utils.formatTime), number of goals total/completed/required/required completed, damage per vehicle (vehData.damage) and the allRequiredComplete flag.

delivery.desc: Data of the loaded delivery (vehicles list with id and name).

startTime.desc: Start time in seconds, measured with os.clock().

returns.desc: {time, timeStr, goalsTotal, goalsCompleted, goalsRequired, goalsRequiredCompleted, vehicleDamages = {[deliveryId] = {name, damage}}, allRequiredComplete}, or nil on error.
